classification.use_limit: Describes source-code structure only. Source choices, frequencies, probabilities, distributions, durations, patient mix, and outcomes are not evidence for real ED routing and are not transferred into parameter records.

source.retrieval_and_hash_procedure: Verified local checkout HEAD with git rev-parse; verified exact committed file using git show at the bound commit/path; computed SHA-256 over full file bytes. For each line range, split bytes with line endings preserved and computed SHA-256 over the inclusive one-based original lines.

line_ranges.context: Scenario documentation and initialization context for sampled pathway parameters.
Creates sampled distributions used for patient class and optional-treatment decisions; no parameter values are adopted here.
Defines a distinct trauma pathway class and its sequential pathway outline.
Defines the non-trauma pathway class and describes a post-examination optional treatment structure.
Implementation of an optional treatment branch after examination, followed by shared departure handling.
Samples an arrival class, constructs the corresponding pathway object, and starts its process.

method_observed.arrival_class_branch: The arrivals generator samples a class attribute and conditionally constructs one of two pathway classes; each pathway then executes as its own process.
method_observed.optional_path: Within the non-trauma process, a sampled treatment-requirement attribute controls whether the treatment resource step runs after examination; patients then rejoin shared departure handling.
method_observed.generalizable_method_description: A teaching model can represent pathway alternatives as separate process classes and optional downstream steps as a conditional branch controlled by a sampled attribute. The code illustrates one implementation pattern only.
